RAV4.title: Toyota RAV4
RAV4.prompt: Buyer wants a reliable Toyota or Lexus SUV, about $30k or less, under 50k miles. DROP: any turbocharged engine (2023+ Highlander gas, 2023+ RX 350, RX 500h, NX 200t/NX 300/NX 350, 2025+ 4Runner) and base Toyota trims (RAV4 LE, Highlander L/LE, Corolla Cross L/LE, plain 4Runner SR5). KEEP any Lexus trim. KEEP both hybrid and gas. In the reason, say whether it's a hybrid and whether the price is good for the year and miles, so a cheap gas car can beat a pricier hybrid.
